validation.scope: Source-shaped Action plus initial Aligned derives exact post memory size/words, alignment and monotonicity; no old Related/Z/raw execution or host bound. Python execution refinement remains separate.

checks: Exact source array lengths determine next size/words; no old Related, raw step, Z or host-cap premise.
All running Action cases covered. Pure and storage actions retain memory; positive stores and COPY use natural splice sizes.
Zero-length COPY preserves input memory and therefore legitimately consumes initial alignment; arbitrary large destination/source offsets are not restricted.
Alignment is initialized from empty memory and preserved; monotonicity and positive access endpoint follow from literal M expansion.
boundaries: Action is the audited source transcription; executable source interpreter extraction remains open.
Host-safety is deliberately a downstream consequence of source memory-cost/work bound, not asserted solely from alignment.
